title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct x component of the field as -iydl/(x^2 + y^2 + z^2)^(3/2).

title: Use of Biot-Savart Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Biot-Savart law to derive the expression for the magnetic field due to the current element.

title: Vector Components
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify that the current is along the z-axis and recognize that the x component of the field is influenced by this orientation.

title: Correct Sign
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes when calculating the x component of the magnetic field.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a check for consistent units throughout the calculation.
